committee: *Presentation-Resolution 228-38 (LS) and Certificate 468-38(LS)-Senator Joe S. San Agustin
title: Hafa Adai! Please join me as I present Legislative Resolution 228-38 and Certificate 468-38 to Guam's Motorcycle Clubs on the occasion of their Biker's Ball and to recognize individuals who made great contributions to their organizations. The presentation will be made to the following clubs: Legends, Cheluship, Guam HAWGS, Harley Owners of Guam and the Brotherhood of Veterans Motorcycle Club and will take place on Friday, October 30, 2026, at 8pm at the Hyatt Regency Guam Ballroom during the Biker's Ball event.
